answer_1.quote: We conducted comprehensive experiments on two NLG evaluation benchmarks: one benchmark for pairwise evaluating instruction-following performance and another for pointwise evaluating the performance of instruction controllable summarization.
answer_1.outputs: Text responses and summaries for given instructions

answer_2.quote: Since the LLMBar dataset does not include cases of a tie, we use accuracy as the evaluation metric... We select the overall criterion and use Pearson, Spearman, and Kendall-Tau correlations as metrics to assess the performance of the evaluation methods.

answer_3.quote: In CAMIEVAL, from the perspective of instruction-following, we define three fundamental dimensions: relevance, factuality, and adherence.
